name: Web analytics
description: Visits, traffic sources, content, audience, forms and server requests from HyperWhirlpool's web domain

config.markdown: Visits to the sites the HyperWhirlpool tracker is on. A **session** is a visit: it ends after 30 minutes without activity. **Visitors** are browser profiles (devices), estimated. Bots and data-centre traffic are left out until *Visitors* says otherwise. Click a slice or a bar to filter the rest; right-click for more.

config.markdown: Each visitor's go at a form on a page. Forms are tracked from **13 October 2026**, and aren't linked to sessions, so only *Form dates* filters them.
